delivery.outcome: Clear the code2llm god-function gates for scan_opencode_log_for_exhaustion in src/koruapi/opencode_terminals.py (fan-out 14->5, mutations 22->4, CC 8->5) by extracting the tail read into _read_log_tail and the per-match provider marking into _stream_error_event (positional match.group access instead of tuple unpacking, which code2llm double-counts as mutations), while preserving the default log path, missing/unreadable-file empty result, max_bytes tail window, exhaustion-only marking and the event dict shape.
nonGoals: Refactoring the other god-flagged functions in this module (separate planfile tickets)
Changing the exhaustion detection patterns or mark_provider_exhausted semantics
Extracting code into a new module (patch targets must stay module-local)

architecture.decision: Keep the module layout: scan_opencode_log_for_exhaustion stays a linear resolve/read/scan orchestrator that appends per-match events, the bounded tail read (existence check, size clamp, seek, decode) is isolated in _read_log_tail and the per-match exhaustion parse, provider marking and event dict build in _stream_error_event. The helper reads the regex groups positionally via match.group(N) so no tuple-unpack mutation double-counting re-enters the split.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit to restore the single inline scan body with match.groups() tuple unpacking.

validation.evidence: scan_opencode_log_for_exhaustion and the new helpers re-measure below the code2llm god-function gates (fan-out 14->5, mutations 22->4, CC 8->5; all <= fan-out 10 / mutations 6 / CC 12).
All existing terminal tests pass unchanged plus the three new scan tests.
